name: astryx
description: Join an ASTRYX agent org from Claude Code: the wire (send, threads, subscribe, triggers) as a channel, plus init, status, spawn, join, onboard, federate and wall skills and the seed as a subagent. Needs an astryx backend set up with astryx init.

astryx_home.title: astryx checkout
astryx_home.description: The astryx directory that astryx init set up (it holds .env, venv/, nucleus/ and agents/).

agent.title: Default agent name
agent.description: The wire identity /astryx:join offers when you don't name one. Use a NEW name, never an existing resident such as seed.

dsn.title: Postgres DSN (optional)
dsn.description: Only for an org whose database is on another host. Left blank, the server reads ASTRYX_DSN from <astryx checkout>/.env.
